landing-page.description: Public marketing landing page for fotogaper (macro & product photography): hero, before/after proof, niche collections, six pricing packages, and the contact/enquiry form.
entryDiscoverySteps: Open BASE_URL + '/en' directly. The landing page is public and needs no sign-in.
Do NOT rely on 'Pricing'/'Contact' nav links scrolling to anchors as navigation — they are in-page '#pricing' and '#contact' anchors.
The '/en/portfolio' route is a separate domain; leave it out of this one.

gallery.description: The public portfolio gallery at /en/portfolio: a browsable index of photographic proofs, with a category filter (all/macro/products/diecast/jewelry), a text search, and a lightbox that opens a proof full-size.
entryDiscoverySteps: Open BASE_URL + '/en/portfolio' directly. The gallery is public and needs no sign-in.
The nav 'Portfolio' link goes here, so it is reachable from the landing page — but enter by URL, because a landing-page nav assertion is the landing-page domain's job.

Filtering and searching are URL-driven: '?category=<pill>' and '?q=<term>'. The search box does NOT filter as you type — it navigates on submit (Enter or the submit button). A test that types and asserts without submitting will see the unfiltered list.
'?category=all' and no parameter are the same list. The empty result renders 'NO MICROSCOPIC PROOFS FOUND.' inside the grid.
The card lightbox is a 'div.fixed.inset-0' overlay with no role="dialog": it closes on the backdrop or the close button, NOT on Escape.
